objective: select ecological support breadth from training data by the same downstream set-level survey-recovery objective used at evaluation, while keeping outer held-out coordinates completely invisible

method.selector: greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells within the support mask
method.selection_rule: for each outer-training fold and survey budget, evaluate every q only on inner spatial holdouts; compute mean paired recall lift versus q=1; if no q<1 has positive mean inner lift, choose q=1; otherwise choose the q<1 with the largest mean inner lift, breaking exact ties toward the broader support (larger q)

controls.fixed_q10: q=0.10 maximum coverage, retained only as the development reference that survived the preceding decomposition

evaluation.primary_question: does the fully nested training-selected policy outperform global maximum coverage without reading outer-held-out coordinates during q selection?
evaluation.secondary_question: does adaptation retain the useful q10 signal without hard-coding q=0.10?

hard_boundaries: Outer-held-out coordinates are invisible to inner q selection.
No Campanula field coordinates are used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
No new environmental variables, q values, K values, or radius are searched in this experiment.
If this procedure fails, retain the failure and diagnose representation or domain structure rather than tuning on outer outcomes.
